test_title: PYST 49: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

After the concert was over, / they go to a restaurant, / had dinner together / and talked until midnight.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect verb form "**go**" instead of "**went**".
 
• The sentence is in the past tense, so the verb should also be in the** past tense.**
 
• The correct phrase should be "**they went to a restaurant**".
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"After the concert was over, they** went **to a restaurant, had dinner together, and talked until midnight."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "had dinner together"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "After the concert was over"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "and talked until midnight"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
